_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Forty-ninth scheduled run, and the largest finding day since the system was built. 17 of 23 URLs served, 10,451 product pages reviewed, and 43 new cases created -- 10 of them Registered. ALMOST ALL OF IT CAME FROM TWO BUGS FIXED AROUND THIS RUN, NOT FROM SELLERS LISTING NEW STOCK. (1) The trademark-symbol fix committed 2026-11-18: normalize() ran NFKD before stripping punctuation, and NFKD decomposes the TM sign into the letters 'TM', which then stuck to the preceding word -- 'Montmartre(TM)' became 'montmarttretm' and matched nothing, while '(R)' names always matched because (R) has no decomposition. 39 of this run's 43 new cases are titles carrying a TM; all are at Redland Ranch Roses, which has been crawled since 2026-09-16 and reported as nearly clean throughout. (2) is_cut_roses_only() moved four Redland Ranch listings to the Cut Roses register during this run, one of them the Registered mark Belle de Noir. All four are sold as '3 GALLON POTTED ROSE - Ships Spring 2027' and are plants; the rule never read variant titles, which was the only field saying so. Fixed the same run by adding variant titles to listing_text(), Redland Ranch was re-crawled, and all four became ordinary cases. The Cut Roses register is empty again, which is its correct state. Also this run: Ergonzi failed with a connection reset on the scheduled pass and served in full on one re-pull, so it is not a gap; Kisaki Plant re-slugged White O'Hara and the redirect check updated KISAKIPLAN-005 rather than opening a duplicate; Xavian's Roses failed exactly as predicted on its first scheduled run.
